prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with long black hair, using an approved adult face reference, sits at a store table and tastes Malatang.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium and close product shots alternate with medium and long shots of the presenter as she lifts ingredients with chopsticks and explains the taste conversationally.

technical_specs.camera: Smooth camera with coherent medium, close, and longer framing.
technical_specs.motion: Lift ingredients, taste, gesture, and speak naturally.
technical_specs.format: Horizontal original aspect ratio, 4K high definition.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a short promotional video in horizontal original aspect ratio. An adult woman with long black hair sits at a table in a Malatang store, using the supplied approved-adult face reference when attached. She eats the Malatang and explains its taste in a friendly colloquial daily-life tone. Use chopsticks to lift featured ingredients such as bursting cheese balls or tender beef for the camera. Combine product medium and close-up shots with medium and long shots of the presenter. Keep her expression friendly and natural, movements soothing, camera smooth, movements coherent, and image quality 4K high definition.
prompt.negative_prompt: blurry, low resolution, watermark, unintended logo, distorted food, unsafe eating, choking, extra fingers, deformed face, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing
